ayahs.arabicText: وَ الذّٰرِیٰتِ ذَرْوًاۙ
ayahs.translation: By the winds which scatter dust,

ayahs.arabicText: فَالْحٰمِلٰتِ وِقْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: which carry clouds laden with water,

ayahs.arabicText: فَالْجٰرِیٰتِ یُسْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: which then smoothly speed along,

ayahs.arabicText: فَالْمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لَصَادِقٌۙ
ayahs.translation: surely what you are being warned against is true,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اِنَّ الدِّیْنَ لَوَاقِعٌؕ
ayahs.translation: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ السَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِۙ
ayahs.translation: By the heaven with its numerous forms:

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكُمْ لَفِیْ قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍۙ
ayahs.translation: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);

ayahs.arabicText: یُّؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ اُفِكَؕ
ayahs.translation: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).

ayahs.arabicText: قُتِلَ الْخَرّٰصُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Doomed are the conjecturers

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ فِیْ غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.

ayahs.arabicText: یَسْئَلُوْنَ اَیَّانَ یَوْمُ الدِّیْنِؕ
ayahs.translation: They ask: “When will the Day of Judgement be?”

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ یُفْتَنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire

ayahs.arabicText: ذُوْقُوْا فِتْنَتَكُمْ١ؕ هٰذَا الَّذِیْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (and be told): “Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ فِیْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ عُیُوْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: As for the God-fearing, they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains,

ayahs.arabicText: اٰخِذِیْنَ مَاۤ اٰتٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):

ayahs.arabicText: كَانُوْا قَلِیْلًا مِّنَ الَّیْلِ مَا یَهْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: they used to sleep but little by night,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ بِالْاَسْحَارِ هُمْ یَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِیْۤ اَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَ الْمَحْرُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِی الْاَرْضِ اٰیٰتٌ لِّلْمُوْقِنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِیْۤ اَنْفُسِكُمْ١ؕ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِی السَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَ مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اِنَّهٗ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَاۤ اَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: So, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is certainly true, as true as the fact of your speaking.

ayahs.arabicText: هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِیْثُ ضَیْفِ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ الْمُكْرَمِیْنَۘ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), did the story of Abraham's honoured guests reach you?

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلَیْهِ فَقَالُوْا سَلٰمًا١ؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ١ۚ قَوْمٌ مُّنْكَرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: When they came to him, they said: “Peace”; he said: “Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَرَاغَ اِلٰۤى اَهْلِهٖ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Then he went back to his family and brought a fat roasted calf

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَرَّبَهٗۤ اِلَیْهِمْ قَالَ اَلَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: and laid it before them, saying: “Will you not eat?”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِیْفَةً١ؕ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ١ؕ وَ بَشَّرُوْهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Then he became afraid of them. They said: “Fear not,” and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَقْبَلَتِ امْرَاَتُهٗ فِیْ صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَ قَالَتْ عَجُوْزٌ عَقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed: “A barren old woman am I.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا كَذٰلِكِ١ۙ قَالَ رَبُّكِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْحَكِیْمُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: They said: “So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَیُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: “Envoys (of Allah), what is your errand?”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنَّاۤ اُرْسِلْنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They replied: “Behold, we have been sent to a wicked people

ayahs.arabicText: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَیْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّنْ طِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones

ayahs.arabicText: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِیْهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Then We evacuated there from all the believers

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِیْهَا غَیْرَ بَیْتٍ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: – and We did not find there any, apart from a single house of Muslims –

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَرَكْنَا فِیْهَاۤ اٰیَةً لِّلَّذِیْنَ یَخَافُوْنَ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِیْمَؕ
ayahs.translation: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِیْ مُوْسٰۤى اِذْ اَرْسَلْنٰهُ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَوَلّٰى بِرُكْنِهٖ وَ قَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.translation: But Pharaoh turned away, showing arrogance on account of his power, and said (about Moses): “He is either a sorcerer or a madman.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخَذْنٰهُ وَ جُنُوْدَهٗ فَنَبَذْنٰهُمْ فِی الْیَمِّ وَ هُوَ مُلِیْمٌؕ
ayahs.translation: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِیْ عَادٍ اِذْ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَیْهِمُ الرِّیْحَ الْعَقِیْمَۚ
ayahs.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad, when We let loose upon them an ominous wind

ayahs.arabicText: مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَیْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَیْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِیْمِؕ
ayahs.translation: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فِیْ ثَمُوْدَ اِذْ قِیْلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوْا حَتّٰى حِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَعَتَوْا عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَ هُمْ یَنْظُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord's command, and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا مِنْ قِیَامٍ وَّ مَا كَانُوْا مُنْتَصِرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَوْمَ نُوْحٍ مِّنْ قَبْلُ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ السَّمَآءَ بَنَیْنٰهَا بِاَیْىدٍ وَّ اِنَّا لَمُوْسِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And heaven – We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْاَرْضَ فَرَشْنٰهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمٰهِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the earth – We spread it out, and how well have We smoothed it!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَیْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.

ayahs.arabicText: فَفِرُّوْۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۚ
ayahs.translation: Flee, therefore, to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَجْعَلُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ١ؕ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۚ
ayahs.translation: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ مَاۤ اَتَى الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌۚ
ayahs.translation: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said: “(He is) a sorcerer, or a mad-man.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَتَوَاصَوْا بِهٖ١ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَاۤ اَنْتَ بِمَلُوْمٍ٢ۗ٘
ayahs.translation: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ ذَكِّرْ فَاِنَّ الذِّكْرٰى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do, however, keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْاِنْسَ اِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;

ayahs.arabicText: مَاۤ اُرِیْدُ مِنْهُمْ مِّنْ رِّزْقٍ وَّ مَاۤ اُرِیْدُ اَنْ یُّطْعِمُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: I desire from them no provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision, the Lord of all power, the Strong.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا ذَنُوْبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوْبِ اَصْحٰبِهِمْ فَلَا یَسْتَعْجِلُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَیْلٌ لِّلَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ یَّوْمِهِمُ الَّذِیْ یُوْعَدُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Woe, then, betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.
